products.title: SanDisk Extreme Pro Portable SSD with USB 4 SDSSDE82 2TB - 619659194376
products.body_html:
Unleash USB4® speeds

Work at a turbocharged pace in external USB drives, with our next-gen USB4® interface. Achieve faster file transfers with read speeds of up to 3800 MB/s2 and write speeds of up to 3700 MB/s.2 

Backwards compatibility

Store and move data across your older USB 3.2 and USB 2.0 devices, and supports Thunderbolt™ 4 as well.

Powerful protection

Help protect your data while on-the-go in various terrain, with a rugged silicone shell and forged aluminum chassis. The IP65 water-resistant design helps withstand splashes, rain, and spills.4 Survive accidental falls with drop protection up to 2 meters.5 

Outstanding reliability

Put your trust in SanDisk. Your storage is backed by a 5-year limited warranty3 to give you peace of mind.

Compatibility issues are not covered under warranty or return.

customers are required to video record the unboxing of the package.

Your life’s an adventure. The SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD fits your mobile lifestyle and accelerates every move. Tested and compatible with iPhone 15 Plus/Pro/Max so you can free up space on your smartphone.

 

Powerful yet Portable

Get fast NVMe™ solid state performance featuring 1050MB/s2 read and 1000MB/s2 write speeds in a portable, high-capacity drive that’s perfect for creating amazing content or capturing incredible footage.

 

Tested to Be Relentlessly Reliable

We devote hundreds of hours of rigorous testing to help make sure your drive is worthy of your best work — and so you know your precious files are in good hands.

 

Back Up and Live Fearlessly

Stay unfazed during power failures, virus attacks, and even natural disasters, because you have an extra copy of what matters most, stored on a drive designed for reliability.

 

Tough Enough to Take with You

Up to three-meter drop protection and IP65 water and dust resistance5 mean this durable drive can take a beating.

 

Travel Worry-Free 

Get extra peace of mind with a 5-year limited warranty3 and a durable silicon shell that offers a premium feel and added protection to the drive’s exterior.

 

It Goes Where You Go
